name: Bills and Forms requires an approved signed-in account

planSteps.description: In a fresh unauthenticated browser, open https://app.kohlestate-ksa.online/bills-forms. Do not enter account credentials or submit a form.
Verify the browser redirects to /login, showing the email/password sign-in form. The Bills and Forms editor, issue-document action and document preview must not be visible.
Switch the login page to English.
Verify Sign in with Google is enabled and the email and password fields remain available; no public registration option is present.
